7995.title: Delegated Cursor credentials are treated as missing
7995.rootCauseOneLine: Linux Cursor maintenance resolves only an inline auth-file token, so a delegated-store marker becomes a null account and unauthenticated usage before any dashboard request.
7995.proposedFix: Validate a supported Linux credential resolver in an isolated signed-in environment, then share it across account and usage without exposing secret values.
7995.caveats: The complete reproduction test and logs are inline. The same agent repeated the synthetic layout reproduction in a second clean trusted checkout. Real CLI authentication, OS-store integration, and encrypted SQLite credentials were not exercised. No PR: authentication handling is excluded from the simple-fix scope.
